landingPage.heroSubtitle: Manage assets, movements, maintenance, and inventories with a modern interface built for operational teams — designed for clarity, traceability, and speed.
landingPage.operationsSubtitle: Everything you need to manage equipment workflows without friction.
landingPage.highlightsAssetsDesc: Track equipment lifecycle, ownership, and movements with clarity.
landingPage.highlightsMaintenanceDesc: Plan interventions, follow steps, and keep history in one place.
landingPage.highlightsStockDesc: Control types, models, compatibility, and inventories across locations.
landingPage.completeModulesTitle: A complete module set, organized the right way
landingPage.completeModulesSubtitle: Your app already includes rich modules across assets, maintenance, stock/consumables, organizational structure, purchasing, and approvals. This landing page highlights those capabilities clearly.
landingPage.assetLifecyclePoints: Types, models, and instances|Default composition & included items|Assignments and traceability
landingPage.maintenanceOperationsPoints: Planning, steps, and execution|History & timelines per asset|Internal & external workflows
landingPage.stockConsumablesPoints: Inventory per location|Compatibility matrices|Receiving and movements
landingPage.securityPoints: Role-based access control|Least-privilege navigation|Clear audit-friendly flows
landingPage.fourStepsTitle: From registration to reporting, in four steps
landingPage.fourStepsSubtitle: A clear operational loop that fits how equipment teams actually work, with minimal clicks and maximum traceability.
landingPage.step1Text: Authenticate and land in a role-aware dashboard with the right modules and actions.
landingPage.step2Text: Define types, models, attributes, and default compositions for consistent data entry.
landingPage.step3Text: Manage movements, requests, maintenance steps, and approvals from a single workspace.
landingPage.step4Text: Use reports and histories to see trends, prevent downtime, and optimize costs.
landingPage.socialProofSubtitle: A glass UI is nice — but clarity and structure are what make the system usable daily.
landingPage.operationsQuote: The workflow feels structured: types → models → instances, with the right approvals in the right places.
landingPage.maintenanceDeskQuote: Having steps, history, and timelines together reduces back-and-forth and helps us close work faster.
landingPage.itBureauQuote: Role-based access keeps sensitive actions controlled while still making the UI fast to navigate.
landingPage.faqSubtitle: Quick answers about the landing page and how it fits your app.
landingPage.faq1Q: Who is the landing page for?
landingPage.faq1A: It is public-facing: it explains the system and provides a clear "Sign in" entry point. Authenticated users are redirected to the dashboard.
landingPage.faq2Q: Does it support glassmorphism without images?
landingPage.faq2A: Yes. It uses layered translucency + blur + gradients (orbs) to create depth, without needing external images.
landingPage.faq3A: Yes. The page is built from small data arrays (capabilities, steps, testimonials, FAQs) so you can edit content quickly.
landingPage.readyTitle: Ready to manage equipment with clarity?
landingPage.readyText: Sign in and jump straight into your role-based dashboard.
